common_limits: Reported completed-project cost and approximate construction cost are evidence categories; neither establishes an audited final payment or an awarded bid.
Tax treatment, contingency treatment, cash versus in-kind support, price escalation, owner costs and inclusions beyond the described works are unspecified unless a record says otherwise.
Amounts retain their historical project years; no escalation to 2026 or extrapolation to a generic per-km or per-m rate was performed.

Locations are supported by sources. Suggested natural-resource-region tags are geographic inferences requiring GIS boundary verification; highway districts and MoTI regions are different classifications.
A restored habitat distance is not road construction length. No habitat distance was used as a costing denominator.
Different reports for the same project may have different dates or accounting boundaries; keep their values separate.

policy.unknown_tax_means: Unknown, never automatically tax-free or tax-inclusive.
policy.region_tags: Research candidates, not verified GIS assignment, TSA, supply block, or appraisal road group.
policy.habitat_km: Ecological output, never constructed road length.
